name: Intelligence Pipeline
description: Response quality augmentation: complexity decomposition, confidence scoring, self-review, multi-pass generation, domain knowledge injection

tierModelMap.description: Maps tier names to model/provider overrides. Example: {"reasoning": {"model": "claude-opus-4-6"}, "tiny": {"model": "claude-haiku-4-5"}}

enhancedCompaction.description: DeerFlow-inspired progressive conversation summarization with configurable triggers

tokenCountThreshold.description: Summarize when estimated tokens exceed this

messageCountThreshold.description: Summarize when message count exceeds this

capacityFraction.description: Summarize when estimated tokens / context window exceeds this

recentWindowSize.description: Number of recent messages to preserve untouched

skipComplexShortConversations.description: Skip summarization for short but complex conversations

complexityThresholdForSkip.description: Avg complexity above which short conversations are not summarized

shortConversationLimit.description: Conversations below this message count are considered short

codingAgentDelegation.description: DeerFlow ACP-inspired delegation of coding tasks to external AI agents (Claude Code CLI, etc.)

defaultAgent.description: Which agent backend to use by default

delegationComplexityThreshold.description: Complexity threshold above which the agent is hinted to delegate

maxConcurrentDelegations.description: Maximum number of concurrent external agent processes

agents.description: Agent backend definitions. Each key is an agent ID with command, args, env, timeoutMs, maxOutputChars, workingDir, promptTemplate

enhancedLoopDetection.description: DeerFlow-inspired enhanced loop detection with early triggers, fuzzy matching, and actionable steering guidance

earlyDetectionThreshold.description: Identical tool+params repeat count before blocking (core default is 10)

fuzzyMatchThreshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold (0-1) for fuzzy param matching

responseLevelDetection.description: Detect when the agent generates near-identical responses repeatedly

responseSimilarityThreshold.description: Text similarity threshold (0-1) for response repetition detection

maxResponseHistory.description: Number of recent responses to track

enabled.label: Enable Intelligence Pipeline
enabled.help: Augment AI responses with complexity analysis, confidence scoring, and quality gates

selfReviewEnabled.label: Self-Review
selfReviewEnabled.help: Enable automatic self-review when confidence is below threshold

multiPassEnabled.label: Multi-Pass Generation
multiPassEnabled.help: Enable 3-pass generation (initial + critic + specialist) for complex tasks

knowledgeSource.label: Knowledge Source
knowledgeSource.help: Where to retrieve domain knowledge: semantic (shared-brain), static (hardcoded), hybrid (semantic with static fallback)
